configuration.sampling: time-stratified random off-grid starts with shuffled balanced phase strata

aggregate_scope_note: aggregate combines all completed query profiles; use `profiles` for per-profile inference.
decision_note: Architecture Owner applies the Phase 2A-0 decision tree; harness reports measurement only.
interpretation_limit: Transcode profiles vary compression, resolution and codec only. Measured perturbation on the current low-frequency DCT descriptor is 1-cos of roughly 6e-6 to 1.3e-5, two to three orders of magnitude below the median correct-vs-best-incorrect score margin of about 3.7e-3. These results must not be generalized to crop, mirror, subtitle overlay, picture-in-picture, or camera capture.
reproducibility_note: Encoders are pinned to single-threaded, frame-parallel-free settings. Two independent full runs of this configuration produced identical statistics across 148 compared fields.
